bill.title: Acknowledging the courage and sacrifice of veterans of the Korean War and Korean Defense Veterans.
bill.latestActionText: Referred to the House Committee on Veterans' Affairs.

classification.plainSummary: This is a House resolution that formally recognizes the courage and sacrifice of veterans who served during the Korean War and those who have served in the defense of Korea since the armistice. As a resolution, it does not change any law, create programs, or allocate funding; it is a ceremonial statement of congressional acknowledgment.

plain.whatItDoes: No one has written a summary of this bill yet. All we have is its title, and a title is not a description of a law. To find out what it does, you have to open the bill itself.
plain.everydayEffect: Nothing has changed yet. The title alone does not say what would change for you, and this tool will not guess. This kind of resolution does not become law, even if it passes.
plain.source: From the bill title, and from the subject labels that library staff put on it. There is no official summary of this bill yet.
